mil5.1.10:0.4: 10. Question on the Display of Psychic Power
mil5.1.10:1.1: “Venerable Nāgasena, this was spoken by the Blessed One:
mil5.1.10:1.2: ‘The four bases of psychic power, Ānanda, have been developed by the Tathāgata, made much of, made a vehicle, made a ground, established, consolidated, and well undertaken. If he wished, Ānanda, the Tathāgata could live for an aeon or for the remainder of an aeon.’
